# Reference Zstd frames

Synthetic UTF-8 CSV input and 22 independent reference frames, generated using
zstd crate 0.13.3 / libzstd 1.5.7. Frames include checksums and intentionally omit
a declared content size, exercising streaming-header compatibility.

`corpus.csv` must retain LF line endings on every platform. Its bytes are the
expected decoded contents of the fixed frames, so `.gitattributes` pins its
checkout format even when `core.autocrlf=true`. Keep byte-for-byte comparisons;
do not normalize the expected data in the decoder tests.

From the repository root, regenerate and cross-check both directions:

```sh
cargo run --manifest-path apps/yydbmanager/tests/zstd-reference/Cargo.toml --release --locked
```

The standalone tool requires a C compiler only for its reference oracle. It is
outside the application dependency graph. Native Zstd is not a development or
normal dependency of yydbmanager. Input is deterministic, generated by the tool,
and contains no real customer data. Do not regenerate fixtures with the Rust
backend under test: their purpose is independent decoder coverage.
